description.en: The ID of the access configuration.

description.zh:
权限策略类型，用于查询的过滤条件。取值：

- System：系统策略。
- Inline：内置策略。

如不指定，则查询所有类型的权限策略。
description.en:
The type of the policy. The type can be used to filter policies. Valid values:

*   System: system policy.
*   Inline: inline policy.

If you do not specify this parameter, all types of policies are queried.

title.zh: 查询访问配置中的权限策略列表

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，查询访问配置`ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj****`中的权限策略列表。返回结果显示，该访问配置中存在一个系统策略和一个内置策略。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to query the policies that are created for the access configuration `ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj****`. The returned result shows that the access configuration contains one system policy and one inline policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudsso list-permission-policies-in-access-configuration --directory-id d-00fc2p610000 --access-configuration-id ac-00jhtfl8thteu6uj0000 --permission-policy-type System --region cn-hangzhou
